items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: I don't know whether you've ever gotten Dan Morgenstern before this

ctx.x: So Eddie Durham, so I got this “Pigeon Walk” which is what set us off on this course. I got it and I immediately noticed, hey, that’s the introduction to “Time Out,” which, and they’re both written by Eddie Durham. So I said well there’s a match. So I had met Eddie Durham so I ran with the record. You couldn’t make it on a cassette, although reel-to-reel tape existed I didn’t have access yet. I got one of those in ’61. So this is probably ’61 or earlier. And although this conversation happened again and again,…
